name: ambient-wide-dark.png
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one elegant wide landscape 16:9 background for Grethel Labs, an open-source software laboratory. The reference image provides only the brand language and palette; do not reproduce its wordmark or literal logo. Derive the background geometry from its angular flask shoulder, broad horizontal G bar and rounded corner transitions. Quiet architectural flat layers, a few broad precise 45-degree planes and one restrained 90-degree teal accent path. Strong negative space across the LEFT two-thirds for text or desktop icons. Put the visual interest in the lower-right third. High-end restrained technical editorial style, visually calm, not playful. No text, labels, numerals, mascots, objects, flask illustration, data chart, particles, circuitry, bubble patterns or sci-fi interface. No bright neon glow, deep 3D, glass blobs, busy grids or stock wave wallpaper. Dark mode: dominant solid ink #111827, slightly lighter layered planes in #182335 and #22334A, very sparse teal #2DB8A8 edges. A barely perceptible broad soft teal atmospheric tint near the lower-right can provide depth, but the left region must remain almost uniform ink. Clean crisp geometry and subtle premium finish. Output only this one complete wide wallpaper edge to edge, preferably at the highest available landscape resolution.

name: ambient-mobile-dark.png
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Input image is a Grethel Labs desktop wallpaper to adapt into a separate MOBILE PORTRAIT wallpaper. Recompose it for a tall 9:16 aspect ratio; do not simply stretch it. Preserve its dark ink #111827 with navy planes and restrained teal #2DB8A8 palette, exact quiet technical visual language, broad clean angled planes, softened elbow geometry and understated teal edge. Keep the upper 60 percent mostly empty and visually calm for a clock or app icons; put the geometric detail in the lower-right corner and lower third. This is a matching companion to the reference, not a new aesthetic. No logo text, letters, numbers, phone frame, icons, bubbles, particles, gradients with bright neon, deep 3D, noisy textures or additional symbols. One beautiful restrained full-frame portrait background, ideally high-resolution.
